epics.description: Orchestrates payment pre-validation, tokenized authorizations, and real-time fraud mitigation.
High-throughput asynchronous refund queueing, 30-day window enforcement, and partial refund handling.
Dynamic currency conversion (DCC), cross-border settlement rails, and international compliance.

features.description: Input payload parsing, Luhn checksum verification, and tokenization gateway.
Low-latency ML scoring pipeline with strict 3-retry exponential backoff resilient against network jitter.
Distributed queue consumers maintaining concurrency limit of 5 per ADR-002.
Automated merchant currency conversion at POS using ECB exchange rate feeds.
Prorated refund math and merchant interchange fee clawback calculations.

stories.summary: Implement Luhn algorithm and expiry verification (REQ-002)
stories.description: Pre-flight validation to reject invalid and expired cards before touching bank networks.

stories.summary: Card authorization tokenization and transaction persistence (REQ-001)
stories.description: PCI-compliant authorization flow and ledger record writing.

stories.summary: Implement 3-retry exponential backoff for fraud scoring (REQ-003, ADR-001)
stories.description: Wrap external fraud API calls with exponential backoff and score threshold enforcement.

stories.summary: Queue refund jobs with concurrency pool of 5 (REQ-006, ADR-002)
stories.description: Background worker pool handling spike loads on /v1/refunds.

stories.summary: Enforce 30-day settlement cutoff on refund requests (REQ-007)
stories.description: Reject refund requests exceeding 30 calendar days with REFUND_WINDOW_EXCEEDED.

stories.summary: Integrate real-time forex rate provider for DCC (REQ-004, ADR-003)
stories.description: Connect to European Central Bank daily forex feed for multi-currency conversion. Cross-Team Synergy: Reuse fraud_detector.retry_with_backoff (ADR-001) for outbound ECB HTTP requests to accelerate delivery by ~5-8 story points.

stories.summary: Partial refund calculation and fee deduction (REQ-008, ADR-003)
stories.description: Support partial settlement amount refunding against original transaction. Blocked on merchant interchange clawback accounting rule. Cross-Domain Unblocking: Pair with Alice Chen (payment_service) to reuse existing merchant fee schedule math from PAY-FEAT-201.
stories.blocker_reason: Blocked: Awaiting legal and accounting clearance on merchant interchange fee clawback accounting rule.

stories.summary: Strict payment idempotency check with Redis distributed locks (REQ-009, ADR-003)
stories.description: Atomically verify and lock idempotency keys for 120s to prevent double charges. Standardized cross-service idempotency lock pattern per ADR-003.
